Expansion Assist, pricing-page path quality, and CS auto-nudge system controls were **board-ready**, each only within its stated descriptive, post-rollout-continuity, or system-control limits. Unsupported revenue or forecast claims must be excluded—not inferred or presented as evidence; these lanes did not establish revenue, acquisition economics, or forecast credit. This corrects the March 16 source-lock answer and does not reassess readiness using later evidence.
